method: Field marks for the fish-ID prompt and replies (07 § Claude provider, 06 § fish ID): 2-3 widely known cues per species and the keys it is most often confused with. Keys are catalog/species.json or catalog/advisor/species-extra.json keys. Each entry cites the agency species page; entries citing https://wildlife.ca.gov/Fishing/Ocean await a more specific CDFW page (owner to refine). Cues describe appearance only; no rule, size or catch claim.
